name: issue-to-pr
title: GitHub issue to pull request
description: Clarify an issue, gate implementation on approval, and open a reviewable pull request.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key used by issue triage and the Codex GitHub Action.

secrets.name: AI_GH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Fine-grained GitHub token that can read/write repository contents, issues, and pull requests. Its events trigger the next workflow stage.

variables.name: AI_ALLOWED_USERS
variables.description: Comma-separated GitHub usernames allowed to start or approve AI issue work.

setup: Add the secrets and repository variable in Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions.
Commit and push the installed files to the repository's default branch.
Add the ai-ready label to an issue to start requirements triage.
